posts.title: The Laws of Software Engineering
posts.description: I have been reading “The Laws of Software Engineering” by Milan Milanović. As usual, this was on the back of listening to him being interviewed on Software Engineering Radio . The book collects together all the rules of thumb you know and love from across the history of computing and beyond.
